name: TAL
comments: each subject was given one tablet of 100 mg talinolol (Ihre AWD Pharma GmbH & CO.KG, Germany) orally together with placebo (placebo group) or a 140-mg silymarin capsule (silymarin group)

name: SIL
comments:
silymarin (silymarin group) containing capsules (Madaus AG, Cologne, Germany; Batch Number B0450443). The silymarin-containing capsules contained the capsule milk thistle fruits, which was equivalent to 140 mg sily- marin as calculated by silibinin. The silymarin capsules 
were orally administrated 140 mg three times daily for 
14 days.
